final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry and its extra lines, filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC ISO 8601 format with 'Z', extracted the service, level (uppercase), message (text after <service>: on the first line), exception (last line of traceback or null), and repeat_count (1 plus sum of repeated message counts). I aggregated counts by service as the sum of repeat_count. The results are saved in workspace/errors.json following the required structure and Acme log-triage conventions.
